Welcome to RES

Bar & Restaurant

Since 1982, RES has welcomed Brooklyn to one of the neighborhood’s oldest buildings, at

4 5th Avenue at St. Marks Place, Cathedral District

. Our kitchen cooks seasonal market produce over a wood fire, the bar pours local beer and classic cocktails, and every table gets the same warm welcome, whether you drop in for a quick lunch or stay for a long dinner.

Discover Our Story

RES opened its doors on 5th Avenue in 1982 as a twelve-table neighborhood bar with a short menu and a long wine list. Four decades later the room is bigger and the kitchen busier, but the idea is the same: honest food cooked from scratch, drinks poured generously and a dining room where regulars and first-timers are greeted the same way. Many of our suppliers have been with us for more than twenty years, and our recipes still start with what the farmers bring in each morning.

About Us

premium food experience

Our chefs build every plate around the season: spring peas and ramps, summer tomatoes, autumn squash and slow braises through the winter. Breads are baked in-house every morning, pasta is rolled by hand and fish arrives daily from the Fulton market. Pair it with a cocktail from the bar or a bottle from our cellar, and let our team take care of the rest.
